name: Existing installation: physical-host consent and Portal sign-in boundary
summary: An actual fresh Chromium browser on this physical host opened the installed app's current staging Remote access screen and the configured public Portal. The local screen required relay consent, and the Portal rendered Sign in or sign up. The local relay was off with no installation identity, linked account, consent, desktop grant or connector. This receipt verifies the observed human prerequisites only. No connection, Noise channel, desktop roster, frame or input was established.

assertions.evidence: Chromium navigated to http://127.0.0.1:3170/settings/remote-access#connect-computer; HTTP 200, title Papercusp Operator. After hydration the Papercusp relay card displayed its notice, I understand, and Agree.

Chromium navigated to https://app.papercusp.com/; HTTP 200, title Papercusp Portal. A bounded locator wait observed Sign in or sign up, followed by Sign in and Create account. A fresh browser context had no authenticated Portal account.

The real local GET /api/remote-access/portal-relay returned 200 with state off, installId null, consent.agreed false, linked null, desktop.grant null, connector null and health off. No consent, pairing or desktop-grant POST was made.

Receiving account and organization remain unselected. Avi must choose the receiving Portal account/organization, sign in, and approve the local relay notice and receiving Portal request before desktop access can be approved. The attempt stopped at those measured prerequisites.

connectionEstablished is false. Connector/channel authorization, Noise handshake, roster, desktop frames and input are explicitly not exercised. A passing receipt records the attempt and its boundary; it does not record a working desktop connection.

execution.browser: Playwright Chromium, headless, fresh nonpersistent context
execution.commandDescription: Two inline Node/Playwright browser observations and a read-only loopback status request; no account cookies, credential injection or connection mutation.
execution.runtimeContainment: dev:pipeline_position measured the portal-relay route present on staging-operator. The physical attempt exercised the served build, not the current uncommitted source tree or a final release.
